data.body: RCA/TDD evidence: root cause is routing drift after IMPACT_MODEL_VERSION moved to code-v5 while security/concurrency thresholds still reflected earlier corpora; prerequisite Gerrit 2861 supplied the missing reproducible code-v5 calibration artifact. RED: after updating tests first, targeted suite failed on unchanged routing/docs (5 failures: superseded decision absent; concurrency not in blocking set; security/concurrency old thresholds). GREEN: updated only routing, derived tests, and calibration-doc supersession. Validation: targeted six-file suite passed (74 passed); derived-threshold temporary 0.60 oracle passed (18 passed) and was restored; make lint passed; make typecheck passed; full make verify PYTEST_WORKERS=2 passed with GIT_CONFIG_* unset.
